params.caption: 🎮 Half-Life 2: Episode 3 code leak hints at Valve's lost plans A source code leak for the never-released Half-Life 2: Episode 3 is revealing more of what Valve apparently had in mind for the sequel. Among the finds is "The Weaponizer", a weapon reportedly meant to rival the iconic Gravity Gun. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 19:19 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #HalfLife #Valve #GamingNews
